import csv, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, collections, sys, os
base=pathlib.Path("workspaces/repository-file-inventory-20261109")
progress=json.loads((base/"progress.json").read_text())
runs={
"Canonical-Skills-Location":42573859935,
"CommandLine":42573703776,
"Execution-Contract-Controller":42573862688,
"IssueScratch":42573864857,
"IssueStack-":42573867528,
"MCP-Collaborative":42573869494,
"StateMachines":42573871895,
"Surfaces":42573874240,
"Terminals":42573876389
}
assert list(runs)==progress["order"]
overall=collections.Counter()
sums=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="reconcile-expression-artifacts-") as root:
 for name,run in runs.items():
  folder=pathlib.Path(root)/name
  folder.mkdir()
  cmd=["gh","run","download",str(run),"--repo","BestNameYet/Terminals","--name","codespace-mcp-expression-inventory","--dir",str(folder)]
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=100)
  if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError("ARTIFACT DOWNLOAD FAILED "+name+" "+p.stderr[-600:])
  manifest=json.loads((folder/"manifest.json").read_text())
  expected=json.loads((base/"repos"/name/"files.json").read_text())["rows"]
  records=manifest["files"]
  assert len(records)==len(expected),(name,len(records),len(expected))
  statuses=collections.Counter()
  expression_count=0
  for index,(entry,src) in enumerate(zip(records,expected)):
   assert entry["index"]==index,(name,index,entry.get("index"))
   assert entry["file"]==src["relative_file_path"],(name,index,entry.get("file"),src["relative_file_path"])
   status=entry["status"]
   statuses[status]+=1
   if src["language"]=="javascript":
    assert status in ["ok","error"],(name,index,status)
   else:
    assert status=="skipped_non_javascript",(name,index,status)
   if status=="ok":
    jfile=folder/pathlib.Path(entry["json"]).name
    cfile=folder/pathlib.Path(entry["csv"]).name
    assert jfile.is_file() and cfile.is_file(),(name,index,"missing output")
    data=json.loads(jfile.read_text())
    assert len(data["expressions"])==entry["expression_count"],(name,index,"count mismatch")
    expression_count+=len(data["expressions"])
  overall.update(statuses)
  summary={"repository":name,"workflow_run":run,"rows":len(records),"statuses":dict(statuses),"expressions":expression_count,
           "failures":[{"path":r["file"],"error":r["error"]} for r in records if r["status"]=="error"]}
  sums.append(summary)
  print("RECONCILED "+json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
print("TOTAL "+json.dumps({"repository_count":len(sums),"input_file_rows":sum(x["rows"] for x in sums),
  "status_counts":dict(overall),"expressions":sum(x["expressions"] for x in sums),
  "parse_errors":sum(len(x["failures"]) for x in sums)},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
